title: inbox_url derivation in handle_follow is dead code
description: Lines 103-107 in inbox.rs compute inbox_url via a conditional but both branches produce the same result: format!('{}/inbox', actor_url). The activity['object'].as_str() check with .and_then(|_| ...) maps over an Option only to discard it. The block stores actor_url + '/inbox' unconditionally. This is wrong for any Mastodon actor whose inbox is not at /inbox (e.g. /users/alice/inbox). The correct fix is to fetch the actor document and read the inbox field. As written, Accept{Follow} deliveries go to the wrong URL for non-trivial actor URLs, which means the Accept is never received and the follower's client may retry. Will generate repeating issue reports from users whose clients never get accepted.
